slides.title: New camera angles for every ball
slides.text: Follows lofted shots from the air and cuts to the batter before the ball. Turn it on in Settings › Camera.

slides.title: ExtraWipe: TV-style transitions into every replay
slides.text: Every replay now opens and closes with a smooth broadcast wipe, like on TV. Works in every competition and with any scoreboard mod.

slides.title: ExtraCard: TV-style player cards
slides.text: Restyles the cards shown when a batter walks in or out, reaches a milestone, or a bowler comes on, plus the coin toss and pitch report. Your scoreboard stays as it is.

slides.title: Try new mods before they're public
slides.text: Members get early-access mods, can ask for new ones, and get help if something breaks.
